ns2:section.sectionText: Seats are reserved for LAS Access and Achievement Program students, specifically for EOP and PAP students in the college of Liberal Arts & Sciences. If you do not meet this requirement, please contact the Access and Achievement Program Office in 112 English Building to be placed on the waiting list.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Liberal Arts & Sciences. Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to EOAP Std Ath&Affil-LAS AAP, EOP - Obligatory, Pres Award Program Recip, President's Award Honors, or AAP - Undeclared students.
